title: Paloma and the Hollow
premise: Odile Brightwater, exiled for a storm that killed the wrong man, hides as ledger-keeper for the Gilded Hollow, a guild trading in impossible things. When a mute child arrives speaking the First Tongue, Odile learns the child carries a stolen soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and that the last dragon-fire keeping both courts alive is guttering. To save the child, Odile must betray the guild master who once sheltered them, confront the judge who exiled them, and choose between restoring their own name and returning the soul to its rightful body. In the end, Odile rekindles the dragon-fire with their own storm-gift, sacrificing exile's safety forever, and finds that loyalty kept honestly is worth more than innocence preserved by silence.
about_author: Dominic Sterling is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing merchant guild records in coastal port cities, an obsession that bleeds into every ledger, contract, and debt in his fiction. He writes fantasy about people trapped by paperwork and freed by conscience, and claims he has never once balanced his own accounts.

chapters.title: The Weight of Unwritten Things
chapters.summary: Odile Brightwater catalogs the Gilded Hollow's strangest inventory—a bottled echo, a debt payable in years—establishing her careful, invisible life. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: wary contentment built on buried guilt over the storm she called and the man it killed.

chapters.title: A Child at the Door
chapters.summary: On a night of unnatural stillness, a mute child arrives clutching a hollow iron ring, speaking words no living tongue should know. The guild master, Corvane, orders the child turned away; Odile disobeys. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: first crack in her enforced neutrality—recognition of herself in another exile.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Souls
chapters.summary: Decoding the child's speech through old trade-tongues, Odile finds a hidden page in the guild's founding ledger: a soul sold to the Undercourt beneath the mountain, signed by Corvane himself. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: betrayal—the man who sheltered her built the Hollow on this sale.

chapters.title: What Corvane Owes
chapters.summary: Corvane confesses partially: he sold the soul to buy the Hollow's charter from the Undercourt, believing it mindless. Now the dragon-fire sustaining both realms gutters, and the Undercourt calls in all debts. POV: alternating Odile/Corvane. Emotional beat: loyalty strained against truth; neither can look away.

chapters.title: The Road Beneath
chapters.summary: Odile flees with the child, pursued by the Hollow's collectors, guided by a disgraced lantern-keeper named Sef who knows the mountain's service tunnels. POV: Odile, with Sef's interludes. Emotional beat: fugitive terror softening into unexpected trust and the first stirrings of love.

chapters.title: The Judge of Storms
chapters.summary: Passing through the border city, Odile is recognized and dragged before Magistrate Hale—the judge who exiled her. He offers pardon in exchange for surrendering the child as evidence. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: love against duty; she refuses justice defined by the law that wronged her.

chapters.title: Doors of Bone and Bargain
chapters.summary: In the Undercourt's antechamber, the child's soul-broker demands a price: a memory of equal weight. Odile offers her memory of the storm—and the truth of who really died that day. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: devastating self-sacrifice; she pays not knowing what she'll lose.

chapters.title: The Court Beneath the Mountain
chapters.summary: Before the Undercourt's throne, Odile discovers the sold soul belongs to the child itself—its voice, its name, its future. The dragon-fire's keeper reveals the fire dies unless fed by a willing storm-caller. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: horror transmuting into resolve; the climax begins.

chapters.title: Stormfire
chapters.summary: Odile calls the storm she swore never to call again, channeling it into the dying dragon-fire while Corvane arrives to void his own contract at terrible cost. The soul returns to the child, who speaks its own name aloud: Paloma. POV: Odile, then Paloma. Emotional beat: climactic sacrifice and rebirth.

chapters.title: The Open Ledger
chapters.summary: The Hollow reopens under new law—every debt written honestly, Corvane serving out his term among those he wronged. Odile, exile no longer but never again invisible, teaches Paloma the storm-calling craft. POV: Odile. Emotional beat: quiet resolution; loyalty and truth finally aligned.
